caption: The drawing depicts a single shoe viewed from above. The shoe is primarily dark blue, with a light tan interior section visible along the open top. There is a decorative element at the front of the shoe consisting of intricate, symmetrical patterns in red, with a central scalloped area surrounded by ornate lines and swirls. The decorative red section covers the toe area and extends slightly upward, bordered by a ruffled texture in the same red color along the opening of the shoe. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or markings, bringing full attention to the shoe’s details and colors.
title: Evening Slipper
